breakdown.title: Operations Breakdown
breakdown.description: Bring users, revenue, model capabilities, and setup progress into one dashboard for business-style monitoring.

resource.activeUsersDetail: Unique users over the last {days} days

modelDistribution.title: Model Distribution
modelDistribution.description: Request share by model over the last 7 days, to help tune default models and plan costs.

entrySource.title: Entry Source
entrySource.description: See whether requests come from the canvas, image workbench, or video studio.

contentType.title: Content Type
contentType.description: Track generation types like image and video for operations insight.

businessHealth.title: Business Health
businessHealth.description: The dashboard homepage only shows operational signals; media file maintenance has moved to the Local Media page.
businessHealth.failedCallsDetail: Use this to investigate model, quota, or upstream issues
businessHealth.assetIssuesDetail: Log entry exists but the file is missing

usageTrend.title: Request Trend
usageTrend.description: User request curve over the last 7 days, to help judge growth, anomalies, and endpoint stability.

overview.label: Dashboard
overview.description: View user growth, request trends, revenue overview, and model request distribution.

users.label: Users
users.description: Manage user roles, account status, plan assignment, and points balance.

logs.label: Activity Log
logs.description: Track user generation tasks, model calls, entry sources, and failure reasons.

generationOperations.label: Generation Ops
generationOperations.description: View generation tasks, sessions, projects, channel health, and point costs in one place.

products.label: Products
products.description: Configure plans, pricing, points entitlements, and validity shown in the top-up center.

orders.label: Orders
orders.description: Process top-up orders, payment confirmation, refund flags, and basic reconciliation.

points.label: Points Rules
points.description: Configure free daily points, base model charges, and generation parameter multipliers.

payments.label: Payment Channels
payments.description: Configure Stripe, Alipay, WeChat Pay, PayPly, and manual confirmation channels.

cdk.label: CDK Codes
cdk.description: Generate and manage points or plan redemption codes for promotions and aftersales.

wallet.label: Ledger
wallet.description: View fund flow, points liabilities, and revenue/refund reconciliation.

site.label: Site Profile
site.description: Manage the site title, logo, SEO title, description, and keywords.

channels.label: Model Channels
channels.description: Add upstream endpoints, fetch models, test availability, and set default models.

skills.label: Agent Skills
skills.description: Manage Agent skills, trigger words, sources, and execution rules.

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Manage registration policy, email service, and generation defaults.

accountDeletion.label: Deletion Requests
accountDeletion.description: Review account deletion requests, complete identity verification, approve or reject, and keep audit records.

mediaStorage.label: Local Media
mediaStorage.description: View server images, videos, and audio files; manage retention and long-term storage.

externalStorage.label: External Storage
externalStorage.description: Configure S3-compatible storage, migrate local media, and manage external objects.

backup.label: Backups
backup.description: Export and restore anonymized business data, distinguishing full-database and media backup scope.

updates.label: Updates
updates.description: View version updates, changelogs, and the GitHub open-source repository in one place.

announcements.label: Announcements
announcements.description: Publish site announcements and set homepage or post-login popup reach.

prompts.label: Prompt Ops
prompts.description: Maintain public prompts shown in the user-facing prompt library.

users.title: User Management
users.description: Adjust roles, account status, and points balance.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by nickname, username, email, role, or status
users.bulkDeleteConfirmDescription: This clears each user's sessions, points, and quota records one by one. Your own account and the last remaining admin cannot be deleted.
users.cannotSelectSelf: You can't select the currently signed-in account

table.deleteConfirmDescription: This also clears the user's sessions, points, quota records, generation logs, and server-side files.

wallet.title: Ledger
wallet.description: View revenue, refunds, points liabilities, and reconciliation. Plans, orders, and payment channels are managed separately.

metrics.userBalanceDetail: Total current points across all users

topupIncome.title: Top-up Income
topupIncome.description: From {count} paid orders and successful payment records.

refundExpense.title: Refund Expense
refundExpense.description: From {count} refunds flagged, used to reconcile net income.

netIncome.title: Net Income
netIncome.description: Paid order amount minus refunds flagged; can later connect to the payment provider's actual settlement flow.

pointsLiability.title: Points Liability
pointsLiability.description: Current points balance across all users, representing generation quota the platform still owes.

reconciliationNote.title: Ledger Scope Notes
reconciliationNote.description: The ledger only covers revenue, refunds, points liabilities, and reconciliation. Products own product entitlements, Orders own payment and aftersales, and Payment Channels own keys and callbacks.

points.title: Points Rules
points.description: Configure free daily quota, base model charges, and image/video parameter multipliers in one place.

freeDailyPoints.title: Free Daily Points
freeDailyPoints.description: Users without a plan automatically get this every day, valid same-day only. Plan daily bonuses are set in product config and unaffected by this toggle.

modelCost.title: Base Model Charges
modelCost.description: Base model points are deducted first for each generation. Models with a custom value use it; all others use the shared default.
modelCost.defaultLabel: Default charge per call for other models
modelCost.addLabel: Add a custom charge for a model
modelCost.addPlaceholder: Enter any model name, e.g. grok-imagine-video
modelCost.currentShowing: Showing {capability} models. Each value is the base points deducted per call for that model.
modelCost.emptyState: No {capability} models yet. Configure this capability under Model Channels first.

multiplier.title: Generation Parameter Multipliers
multiplier.description: Final charge = model cost x image count/video task x matching multiplier. Unmatched custom parameters use a 1x multiplier.

detail.noAccessibleMedia: This log has no accessible media files.
detail.noSuccessResult: This log has no successful result, so there's no image or video to preview yet.
